description: Probability a player scores a rushing or receiving touchdown in the game. QB passing TDs are NOT credited to the QB — only the scorer (runner/receiver) gets an ATD. QB ATD = rushing TDs only.

availability.note: Live injury/inactive status comes from the ESPN league-wide injuries endpoint (nflverse's injury feed has no data after 2024). OUT/IR/suspended players are zeroed and flagged; questionable/doubtful are discounted. Per-game official inactives (T-90) and OpticOdds ATD markets are still a follow-up.
